description: Don't let a slow ssh connection trip up your typing speed

summary.one_liner: lazysession is an early-stage Go project whose stated goal, from its GitHub description, is to keep a slow SSH connection from disrupting typing speed.
summary.what_it_does: The README is only a title and a single line saying the project is a work in progress. It does not describe any features, commands, or how the tool works. The GitHub description says it aims to stop a slow SSH connection from hurting typing speed, but the README does not explain how. The main language is Go and the license is MIT, per GitHub metadata.
use_cases: remote typing over slow SSH connections
reducing input lag in remote terminal sessions
notable: Describes itself as work in progress; the README gives no feature details
Targets latency in SSH terminal sessions, per the GitHub description
caveats: README is nearly empty and marked work in progress, so functionality is unverified
No installation or usage instructions are provided
